title: Exact Tree–Theta-Trinet Collisions under the Kimura 2- and 3-Parameter Models
strongest_supported_claim: Exact strict-interior K2P tree–theta collisions, including an edgewise strict-continuous-time example; full theta ranks nine and fifteen, local collision dimensions 17 and 23 and fixed-output fibers 11 and 14; local observably genuine K3P collisions including in an edgewise strict-continuous-time chamber; and full-distribution preservation by one theta insertion at any internal vertex of any labelled unrooted binary tree, under the stated rooting and independent-parent-mixture conventions.
exact_checked_claims: Literal rooted theta graph, four independent-parent displayed-tree mixture terms, Klein-group Fourier conventions and all 64 ordinary-pruning probabilities agree.
Compact Q(sqrt(71)) K2P collision has strictly positive transition and pattern probabilities and the stated exact minimum pattern probability.
Cubic strict-continuous-time K2P witness satisfies the exact field equations, isolated real embedding, all 64 probabilities, strict edgewise rate inequalities and the nonzero rank-nine minor.

The fixed-child-order invariant obstruction is supported for the claimed child; changing child order can restore the favorable sign. The initial reviewer test demanding both children was corrected and retained in the log.
Unrestricted K2P and K3P theta Jacobian minors are nonzero, with explicit exact values independently derived from graph monomials.
Positive tree pair-coordinate recovery and rank give embedded tree dimensions six and nine; transverse preimages and local submersions give the stated local collision and fiber dimensions.
The two-equation symmetric K2P family is sufficient in the positive chamber and has the stated rank-two family Jacobian.
The quartic K3P witness has a network edge outside every global K2P equal-pair specialization, but its shared distribution is globally relabelled K2P and not JC.

The fifteen-pivot implicit-function construction has an exact kernel tangent and strictly positive derivatives of its two initially zero CT margins; the invertible Jacobian supplies an actual local analytic branch.

Local theta sections cover tree neighborhoods; removing the three global equal-pair tree strata gives observably genuine K3P outputs. Applying the same argument at a strict CT branch point preserves edgewise CT scope.
Full real rank implies the claimed Zariski closures in the effective affine coordinates, while generic theta parameters are not tree-equivalent.

The universal common-subtree-kernel proof preserves all leaf probabilities after one theta replacement; compatible rooting, strict level-two topology, square-root subdivision and CT preservation were checked.

JC graft kernels have full column rank and character-permutation equivariance, so the extension preserves observable genuineness; fresh finite controls cover 63 replacements across three binary-tree families.
Primary v2/v3 definitions and claimed removed K2P interfaces agree with the manuscript scope; nice-network exclusions in the separate level-two reference do not include the theta trinet.
All ten submitted verification stages passed from an unchanged private copy; both internal manifests and the equality of bundled/public main PDFs were checked.
assumptions: Uniform root distribution, symmetric group-based four-state K2P/K3P transitions in the stated character order.
Independent parent choices at the two reticulations; the literal graph and outgoing-edge parameter placement are essential.
Stated restricted stochastic positive-definite nonidentity domain; witnesses additionally have strictly positive entries and inheritance weights in (0,1).
Continuous-time generators and times are edgewise and heterogeneous; no common generator, global clock or shared node-time constraints.
Observable genuineness excludes only the three globally fixed character-pair equalities; it is distinct from merely breaking equality at some network edge.
All-leaf extension concerns one theta replacement and compatible common attached components, not arbitrary composability of several blobs.

caveats.location: Page 12, construction paragraph after Theorem 12 and Eq. (17)
caveats.issue: The phrase that factorization equations force e/d=6/5 is false for the unrestricted positive ansatz but correct with the equal-nontrivial-B specialization used immediately before it.
caveats.unrestricted_counterexample: h>0, 5h^4=1, tau=1/3, b=h, kappa=3h^2, d=e=1/4 gives exact positive tree factorization with B=(1,h^2/2,h^2/2,5h^2/12), hence e/d=1.
caveats.adjudication: The paragraph describes derivation of the preceding equal-B quartic point; submitted source also imposes a common scalar r and scale condition. Independent constrained algebra forces e/d=6/5. This is not a demonstrated failure of Theorem 12 or Theorems 13–19.
caveats.warning: COUNTEREXAMPLE_CONFIRMED in the narrow control output means the unrestricted ansatz-only reading, not the main paper verdict.

caveats.issue: The cited v3 Lemma 5.5 already excludes JC trinet collisions with a nontrivial 3-blob under the same restricted model. This should not be promoted as a new unresolved question without changed assumptions.

exact_remaining_gap: No remaining mathematical gap identified for the main stated claims in this review. The page-12 necessity wording needs its contextual equal-B restriction; the JC future-question wording needs a changed-model qualification. Neither is a main-theorem counterexample.

independent_controls.source: own exact arithmetic, state pruning, graph monomial differentiation, number-field embedding and finite graph controls

independence.targeted_collaboration_disclosed: Parent supplied e=d candidate and later equal-B interpretation after full manuscript reading; both were independently checked. Incidental prior-confirmation claims in acknowledgments were excluded as evidence.

limitations: AI-assisted review, not human peer review or formal proof-assistant verification.
No worldwide novelty or priority certification.
No common-generator or clock conclusion, generic theta tree-equivalence, arbitrary multi-blob composition, four-attachment-blob collision, or global intersection classification.
Finite controls support but do not replace the universal written arguments.
Mathematical source and principal verifier paths were inspected; no claim of line-by-line audit of every mutation-test boilerplate path.
